scope: One opt-in fixed HTTP loopback diagnostic. It does not integrate the JVM into the main reader or establish production-source, HTTPS-transport, physical-device or full-G4 compatibility.

runtimeDependencies.normal: Existing runtime graph: Okio 3.9.1, no OkHttp or diagnostic helper.
runtimeDependencies.diagnostic: Opt-in testRuntimeClasspath: okhttp-jvm 5.4.0, okio-jvm 3.17.0; unchanged Kotlin 2.4.20.

reference.policy: Preserve original collected golden bytes, source fixture and strict comparator. Only actual loopback origin and authority are canonicalized as in the original harness.

acceptance.status: One authenticated Simulator execution passed all fixed HTTP wire checks and strict Android comparison; matching physical-device and complete-G4 validation remain pending.

nativeSimulator.cleanup: Dispatcher, listener, active socket, server worker and isolated session all stopped or closed; active calls and pooled connections are zero; errors are empty.
nativeSimulator.timingScope: One fixed diagnostic run including evidence collection and cleanup, not a production-reader performance percentile.

deviceTargetPackage.audit: Actual ARM64 iPhoneOS executable, thirteen modules, thirty-nine exports, suites/HTTP classes, fixed mainJs/TLS resources and packaged provenance/license hashes verified.

requiredNativeEvidence: Current source, launch PID, report timestamp and Simulator container must authenticate the enclosing report.
TCP and all four TLS cases with successful cleanup must pass before this diagnostic runs.
Seven actual raw HTTP request heads and bodies must reproduce the comparable request snapshot exactly.
Seven consumed response bodies and all ordered header values must equal the peer's retained response bytes.
The isolated task must retain the parent's absolute deadline and close its session, owned calls, pool, dispatcher and server.
The unchanged strict comparator must report zero differences against the pinned actual Android reference.
implementationBoundaries: The dispatcher is scoped only to an isolated diagnostic task; no global host callback or SourceHosts behavior is changed.
Foreign origins and redirects are rejected; the peer listens only on owned IPv4 loopback.
Cancellation covers headers and body reads; tests include both cancellation phases and the inherited absolute deadline.
Duplicate request headers and response header values remain explicit. The pre-existing joined-header behavior of StrResponse remains unchanged.
